cause.rationale: The new c.json() fast path returns Response.json(object), whose output differs from JSON.stringify across runtimes (for example for c.json(undefined)).
cause.evidence: https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/4757 — The revert says Response.json() behaves differently across runtimes, e.g. c.json(undefined), and disables the fast path.

cause.rationale: Pausing dependency tracking around function ref calls removes tracking that is intentional, so function refs whose target depends on reactive state stop re-running.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/vuejs/core/pull/15094 — The revert says function ref dependencies are tracked on purpose; the change caused issue #15039 and regressions in radix-vue.

cause.rationale: Registering every component scope in the SSR context and stopping them after render fires onScopeDispose callbacks on the server, which user code does not expect.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/vuejs/core/pull/14674 — The revert closes issue #14669, 'onScopeDispose is triggered on SSR'.

cause.rationale: Caching dynamic prop sources in a computed re-runs them later outside the component instance, so a source that calls inject() fails with no currentInstance.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/vuejs/core/pull/14194 — The revert says props may call inject, and once converted to computed a dependency update evaluates them with no currentInstance (seen in VitePress).

cause.rationale: With preferOffline, the resolver now returns the cached metadata even when it has no version matching the spec, instead of falling through to the registry.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/pull/10423 — The PR author reverted it the next month: 'Looks like I actually broke prefer offline resolution.'

cause.rationale: Sorting the scripts matched by a pnpm run /regex/ selector lexicographically changes their run order from the package.json order users relied on.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/pull/13175 — The fix PR removes the .sort() on these lines, calling the lexicographic ordering a breaking change in behaviour (issue #13174).

cause.rationale: Moving the end of an ExpressionStatement to the end of its expression, and printing a semicolon for ignored ExpressionStatements, breaks the output of prettier-ignore'd statements.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/19274 — The revert says the change 'causes bug for prettier-ignored node', with a playground repro.

cause.rationale: The adaptive heuristic projects the remaining queue time from the cost of early files, so when early files are faster than the queued ones it opens too few browser sessions.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/10753 — The revert explains that queue x fileCostEMA / sessions underestimates the remaining work and under-provisions sessions.

cause.rationale: Opening lock files read-only breaks exclusive locking on NFS, where flock falls back to lockf and needs the file open for writing.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/18071 — The revert fixes issue #18061 and explains that on NFS flock falls back to lockf, which needs write access for an exclusive lock.

cause.rationale: Matching Dynamic metadata values case-insensitively makes uv treat more PKG-INFO fields as dynamic, which changes resolution for packages such as flash-attn.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/18692 — The revert says '#18669 is the cause of #18690' (a flash-attn incompatibility in uv 0.11).

cause.rationale: The new destination validation rejects a relative root like --target=. (it normalises to an empty path) and refuses legitimate symlinked directories such as /usr/local/man.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21699 — The revert lists both regressions: 'uv pip install --target=.' fails (#21694) and wheels with man pages fail in official Python Docker images (#21692).

cause.rationale: FailFast gets a __hash__ although its fail_fast field is mutable, so an instance's hash changes after mutation.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13536 — The revert links a maintainer comment: FailFast is mutable and so should not be hashable, with a repro where hash() changes after setting fail_fast.

cause.rationale: TypeAdapter.json_schemas() now calls the private _generate_definitions() directly, so a schema generator subclass that overrides generate_definitions() is silently bypassed.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13951 — The revert fixes issue #13950, which names this call as the cause of the regression in 2.14.0.

cause.rationale: Returning a plain formatted error for missing GraphQL scopes, instead of the GraphQLError, stops ProjectsV2IgnorableError from recognising it, so pr view and issue view fail instead of degrading.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/12915 — The revert fixes issue #12904 and explains that ProjectsV2IgnorableError inspects that error to degrade gracefully when the read:project scope is missing.

cause.rationale: Replaying the unchanged prefix of a union with push_normalized skips the literal buckets UnionBuilder uses to count and widen large literal unions, so the change is not behaviour-preserving.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/25049 — The revert links a review comment showing push_normalized can skip the literal-widening invariants in UnionType::map, map_leave_aliases and try_map.

cause.rationale: Deferring a disabled Teleport's mount inside Suspense leaves its component children unmounted while Suspense can still move the branch, and the deferred job mounts into the captured, possibly stale container.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/vuejs/core/pull/14702 — The fix (closing #14701) says the pendingMounts deferral from #14642 leaves vnode.component null, so Suspense.resolve() crashes when it moves the branch; it changes the deferred mount to use the placeholder's current parent.

cause.rationale: The partial chunk keeps a subarray() view of the stream's buffer across reader.read() calls, so a producer that reuses its buffer overwrites bytes before they are digested and corrupts the ETag.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5239 — The fix says generateDigest() retained a subarray() across reads, so a reused buffer could be hashed as [B, B], and that the regression came from #5205.

cause.rationale: Requeueing a package whenever its extra-activation state changes, even when its reachability does not, repeats the propagation so often that uv export goes from under a second to over 60 seconds.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22750 — The revert bisected a severe uv export slowdown (0.44s to over 60s) to this change and calls out repeated propagation of extra-activation state.

cause.rationale: Emitting extra folding ranges for multi-line block header lines that end on the line where the body range starts makes the body fold unreachable in many LSP clients.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/25118 — The revert says the change introduced incorrect folding in several LSP clients: two ranges sharing an end/start line leave the second one inaccessible.

cause.rationale: Dropping the env field initializer looked like a harmless cleanup but makes every request about 2ns slower on JSC/Bun.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5186 — The revert measured ping ~2ns/req slower on JSC/Bun with benchmarks/fetch (25 paired rounds), neutral on V8.

cause.rationale: Keeping the negative constraint only for dynamic union arms wrongly widens non-dynamic arms whose comparison is ambiguous, e.g. an unconstrained T loses its ~Literal[Color.RED] after equality narrowing.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/26093 — The revert explains that non-dynamic arms can still overlap removed alternatives, so T & ~Literal[Color.RED] was incorrectly widened to T.

cause.rationale: Discarding pending narrowing gates at a merge where neither branch changed the place drops deferred call gates too early, so an unrelated nested if can discard a preceding Never call gate and widen the final type.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/26792 — The revert cites a post-merge finding that deferred call gates are dropped too early at nested control-flow merges.

cause.rationale: SecretStr.__eq__ passes str values to secrets.compare_digest(), which only accepts ASCII strings, so comparing two SecretStr values with non-ASCII characters raises TypeError.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13537 — The fix says #13518 made SecretStr equality use secrets.compare_digest(), which raises TypeError for non-ASCII str, and encodes the values to bytes instead.

cause.rationale: Declaring app.fetch with three named parameters means callers that pass only the request trigger an arity fixup on JSC, about 2ns slower per request than the rest-parameter form.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5184 — The revert restores the rest parameter: calling app.fetch(request) with fewer args than declared triggers an arity fixup on JSC (~2ns/req), neutral on V8.

cause.rationale: Turning every non-identifier same-name v-bind argument into an error that compiles to undefined claims syntax that custom transforms rely on, such as Vue Macros' ::foo short-bind, which now compiles to ":foo": undefined.
cause.evidence: https://github.com/vuejs/core/pull/15362 — A maintainer comment on the PR, confirmed by ecosystem-ci, asked for the revert because Vue Macros' ::foo short-bind syntax could no longer be claimed by its custom transform.
